$schema._description: Plugin schema (letbe-ds, post Item 9 vocabulary). Read by the letbe-tokens-figma plugin (Path 2 / Milestone 04) to map L2 token paths onto canvas slots, WCAG pairs, and sidebar categories. The plugin's slot names (bgSubtle, bgAccentEmphasis, etc.) are plugin-internal canvas variable names — they are STABLE across upstream renames. What this block declares is which letbe-ds token fills each slot. NOTE (2026-08-11): editor_rows[].wcag.against is LEGACY — under a $schema.wcag_pairs manifest (present since item 26) the plugin derives badges and the alternatives grid from the manifest and these values are inert; they only drive schemaless JSONs. Literal hexes here mean the canonical on-color ink #f7f5f1 (theme-stable), never a Figma white.

wcag_pairs.what: neutral toast text + action chip on its pill
primary fill vs page (labeled control — shape only)

50.$description: oklch(0.970 0.004 75) — Near-white warm tint. bg-default in light theme.

950.$description: oklch(0.115 0.005 75) — Near-black warm. bg-default in dark theme.

50.$description: oklch(0.985 0.012 72) — Amber uses higher-L ramp throughout to stay vibrant.

500.$description: oklch(0.580 0.182 295) — Brand accent base. Interactive and link color.
oklch(0.620 0.165 45) — Orange base. Categorical use (data series, labels).
oklch(0.620 0.140 205) — Cyan base. Categorical use (data series, labels).

theme.$description: Theme-tunable interactive stroke. Default 1.6px. Used by border-width.action — the L2 stroke that drives focus rings, button borders, input outlines. Editable at runtime via the theme editor's interactive-stroke knob.

3_5x.$description: 3.5 × 4px base (half-step). Backs small glyph slots — status icons, switch thumb, copy buttons.

1.$description: Text font family slot (L1). Default Inter. Worn by body / action / label / caption (and overline) by default — the reading-and-UI face.

2.$description: Headline font family slot (L1). Default matches slot 1 — invisible until a brand picks a display face. Worn by display + heading by default; pick a font here to change headlines without touching body text.

3.$description: Monospace font family slot (L1). Default Roboto Mono. Used by the code role and inline `.lb-code` snippets.

sans.$description: DEPRECATED — kept as a shim during the typography refactor. Use font.family.1 instead. Removed in Slice 7.

S.$description: Mobile base font size (anchor). All typography step sizes derive from base × ratio^n at this mode.

M.$description: Tablet base font size. Default = same as S. Shift to 17–18 for larger tablet reading.

L.$description: Desktop base font size. Default = same as S. Shift to 17–18 for larger desktop reading.

S.$description: Mobile type-scale ratio (Major Third). Each step n = base × 1.25^n. Common ratios: 1.125 Minor 2nd, 1.2 Minor 3rd, 1.25 Major 3rd, 1.333 Perfect 4th, 1.5 Perfect 5th.

M.$description: Tablet type-scale ratio. Default = same as S.

L.$description: Desktop type-scale ratio. Default = same as S.

line-height-method.$description: Line-height calculation method. "4px-grid" (default) snaps line-height to nearest 4px multiple for clean baseline grid. "ratio" applies a fixed multiplier without snapping. Internal — not user-facing.

2xs.$description: Smallest text — fine print, dense captions.
Line height for 11px text — tight but readable on 4px grid.

caps.$description: Uppercase micro-label tracking (overline/group-label voice). Replaces the raw 0.04em design-intent comments that lived in components.css.

spaced.$description: Code-slot display tracking — OTP/verification-code inputs read as separated slots.

500.$description: Maximum allowed. Anything longer feels sluggish.

decelerate.$description: Starts fast, settles gently. For entering elements.

accelerate.$description: Starts slow, exits fast. For departing elements.

spring.$description: Overshoots then settles. Playful — use intentionally.

0.$description: Ground. Document flow. No stacking context.

1.$description: Hairline lift — subtle depth for inline cards and inputs.

focus.$description: Focus ring glow — matches border/focus blue colour.

inverse.$description: Primary text and icons on inverted (dark) surfaces. Theme-flips: light text on dark surfaces in light mode, dark text on light surfaces in dark mode. Pairs with bg.emphasis (e.g. tooltip).

inverse-muted.$description: Secondary/disabled text on inverted (dark) surfaces. Theme-flipping muted variant of fg.inverse. Pairs with theme-flipping disabled bg (bg.disabled).

inverse-strong.$description: Theme-stable light fg (neutral.50 in both themes). Use on saturated/bold colored backgrounds (filled buttons, badges, card media scrims) where the bg doesn't theme-flip and text must always be light. Distinct from fg.inverse / fg.inverse-muted which theme-flip for inverted-luminance surfaces.

7.$description: Categorical color 7 (orange) — bumped one step lighter for dark surfaces.

8.$description: Categorical color 8 (cyan) — bumped one step lighter for dark surfaces.

1.$description: Code highlighting color 1 (violet) — keyword (control flow, declarations, reserved words). Paler stop for dark surfaces.

2.$description: Code highlighting color 2 (blue) — number (numeric literals, function names). Paler stop for dark surfaces.

3.$description: Code highlighting color 3 (green) — string (string literals, template literals). Paler stop for dark surfaces.

4.$description: Code highlighting color 4 (yellow) — attribute (HTML attributes, CSS properties). Paler stop for dark surfaces.

5.$description: Code highlighting color 5 (red) — tag (HTML elements, JSX tags). Paler stop for dark surfaces.

6.$description: Code highlighting color 6 (neutral) — reserved. Paler stop for dark surfaces.

7.$description: Code highlighting color 7 (orange) — reserved. Paler stop for dark surfaces.

8.$description: Code highlighting color 8 (cyan) — reserved. Paler stop for dark surfaces.

display.$description: Family used by display.* roles. Defaults to font.family.2 — the headline/display face (same Inter as slot 1 until a brand remaps it). Theme editor role map can re-point any role.

heading.$description: Family used by heading.* roles. Defaults to font.family.2 — shares the headline face with display.

body.$description: Family used by body.* roles. Defaults to font.family.1 (Inter).

action.$description: Family used by action.* roles (buttons, tabs, links). Defaults to font.family.1 — actions share the text face, per the two-face model (headline face + text face); remap via the role map for a distinct UI voice.

label.$description: Family used by label.* roles. Defaults to font.family.1 (Inter).

caption.$description: Family used by caption.* roles. Defaults to font.family.1 (Inter).

code.$description: Family used by code.* roles (inline code, code blocks, IDs, keycaps, OTP). Defaults to font.family.3 (Roboto Mono). Minted 2026-08-05 with the small-heading/overline/code completion slice.

xl.$description: Largest display. Hero headlines, splash screens.
Page-level heading. Top of major content areas.

xs.$description: Extra-small heading — section titles inside components (inspector sections, card/list titles, toolbar count, brand text). Tracking is NORMAL, a deliberate deviation from the heading group's tight tracking: negative tracking hurts 12-14px legibility.

2xs.$description: Smallest heading — dense-context titles (kanban column headers). Same normal-tracking rationale as heading.xs.

xl.$description: Extra large body. Introductory lead paragraphs.

l.$description: Large body text. Secondary introductory content.

m.$description: Default body text. Base reading size.

s.$description: Small body text. Secondary content, footnotes.

xs.$description: Extra small body. Captions, dense data tables.

s.$description: Small buttons, compact nav, breadcrumb trail.

l.$description: Large label. Prominent buttons, tab labels.

s.$description: Small label. Captions, helper text, badges.

overline.$description: THE uppercase micro-label voice (finally a style — this is the aa4f64c group-label consolidation as a ramp citizen): nav/shell group labels, stat labels, donut center label, inspector labels. Consumers add text-transform: uppercase at the usage site (DTCG typography carries no textCase).

s.$description: Small code — card IDs, keycap text (the item-17 kbd-mono wish).

m.$description: Default code — code-block bodies, inline .lb-code. Size pinned to what the code-block computes today (font.size.s = 14).

l.$description: Display code — OTP/verification-code inputs, spaced tracking reads as slots. Size pinned to CURRENT pixels (font.size.xl = 20; the slice spec draft said font.size.l/18 but the shipped OTP computes 20 — zero-visual-change principle wins, flagged in the handoff).

none.$description: Intentionally sharp corners — tables, dividers, full-bleed sections, progress bars.

interactive.$description: Clickable controls — buttons, toggles, tabs, nav items, segmented controls.

field.$description: Form inputs — text field, select, combobox, search bar, date picker.

surface.$description: Content containers — cards, panels, accordions, wells.

overlay.$description: Floating surfaces — modals, dialogs, dropdowns, popovers, toasts, tooltips.

badge.$description: Status labels — badges, tags, chips. Themeable: can become rectangular in a sharp theme.

media.$description: Media frames — thumbnails, image containers, video embeds.

full.$description: Absolute circle/pill — circular avatars, round icon buttons, status dots. Always pill regardless of theme.

faint.$description: Near-invisible — hover overlays on images, watermarks.

light.$description: Light overlay — scrim on non-blocking surfaces.

opaque.$description: Fully opaque — default for all solid elements.

z-base.$description: Default document stacking — no stacking context.

z-raised.$description: Elevated card, hover state, floating button.

z-sticky.$description: Sticky header, persistent sidebar, floating nav.

z-drawer.$description: Side drawer, off-canvas nav, slide-in panel.

dur-instant.$description: No visible transition — theme swap, layout reflow.

dur-micro.$description: Checkbox tick, toggle snap, icon swap.

dur-fast.$description: Button press feedback, tooltip appear, focus ring.

dur-normal.$description: Hover color change, dropdown open, tab switch.

dur-gentle.$description: Card lift, modal fade-in, accordion expand.

dur-collapse.$description: Large panel collapse / expand, drawer slide.

action.$description: Interactive stroke width. References primitives.size.theme so the theme editor's interactive-stroke knob propagates here. Used by buttons, inputs, focus rings.

icon.$description: Icon stroke width. Defaults to the Brand preset (size.theme, follows Action stroke). Tunable via the Theme editor's Icon Stroke knob; SVG icons inherit this via `svg[stroke-width] { stroke-width: var(--lb-stroke-icon); }`.

xs.$description: 12px — fixed dimension for mini badges, tiny avatars, small chips.

s.$description: 16px — fixed dimension for small inline icons and small badges.

m.$description: 20px — fixed dimension for default UI icons.

l.$description: 24px — fixed dimension for primary action icons.

xl.$description: 32px — fixed dimension for large icons and small button heights.

2xl.$description: 48px — fixed dimension for avatar default size and illustration icons.

dropdown.$description: Dropdown menu and date picker elevation.

focus.$description: Focus ring glow for interactive elements.

fg-primary-default.$description: Text/icon on filled primary button — default. Theme-stable white on saturated accent bg.

fg-primary-hover.$description: Text/icon on filled primary button — hovered.

fg-primary-pressed.$description: Text/icon on filled primary button — pressed.

fg-primary-disabled.$description: Text/icon on filled primary button — disabled.

border-primary-default.$description: Filled primary button border — default (matches bg, no visible border).

bg-secondary-hover.$description: Outlined secondary button background — hovered. Neutral hover wash. State-based accent model 2026-08-03: secondary is NEUTRAL at rest (accent = signal, reserved for primary/links/state).

bg-secondary-pressed.$description: Outlined secondary button background — pressed (one step past hover). State-based accent model 2026-08-03: secondary is NEUTRAL at rest (accent = signal, reserved for primary/links/state).

fg-secondary-default.$description: Text/icon of outlined secondary button — default. State-based accent model 2026-08-03: secondary is NEUTRAL at rest (accent = signal, reserved for primary/links/state).

fg-secondary-hover.$description: Text/icon of outlined secondary button — hovered. State-based accent model 2026-08-03: secondary is NEUTRAL at rest (accent = signal, reserved for primary/links/state).

fg-secondary-pressed.$description: Text/icon of outlined secondary button — pressed. State-based accent model 2026-08-03: secondary is NEUTRAL at rest (accent = signal, reserved for primary/links/state).

fg-secondary-disabled.$description: Text/icon of outlined secondary button — disabled.

border-secondary-default.$description: Outlined secondary button border — default. State-based accent model 2026-08-03: secondary is NEUTRAL at rest (accent = signal, reserved for primary/links/state).

border-secondary-hover.$description: Outlined secondary button border — hovered (steps up from strong). State-based accent model 2026-08-03: secondary is NEUTRAL at rest (accent = signal, reserved for primary/links/state).

border-secondary-pressed.$description: Outlined secondary button border — pressed (steps up from strong). State-based accent model 2026-08-03: secondary is NEUTRAL at rest (accent = signal, reserved for primary/links/state).

fg-danger-default.$description: Text/icon of filled danger button — default. Theme-stable white on saturated red bg.

fg-danger-hover.$description: Text/icon of filled danger button — hovered.

fg-danger-pressed.$description: Text/icon of filled danger button — pressed.

fg-danger-disabled.$description: Text/icon of filled danger button — disabled.

border-danger-default.$description: Filled danger button border — default (matches bg, no visible border).

fg-ghost-default.$description: Text/icon of ghost button — default. State-based accent model 2026-08-03: ghost/utility controls are NEUTRAL at rest.

fg-ghost-hover.$description: Text/icon of ghost button — hovered. State-based accent model 2026-08-03: ghost/utility controls are NEUTRAL at rest.

fg-ghost-pressed.$description: Text/icon of ghost button — pressed. State-based accent model 2026-08-03: ghost/utility controls are NEUTRAL at rest.

bg-selected.$description: Background of selected action element (chip, nav/shell item, table row, tree row, media track, composer tool) — the visible -1 accent tint. Deliberately one step MORE present than passive banner washes (-2 subtle): selection must signal. Re-pointed subtle→muted in the GAP-12 ramp realignment 2026-08-03 (light value unchanged at violet-200; dark quieted violet-700→violet-800).

fg-selected.$description: Text/icon of selected action element (tab, pill, nav item). Routes through fg.accent — the mode-corrected TEXT accent (violet-600 light / violet-400 dark). Re-routed 2026-07-31: the previous bg.accent routing used a FILL color as text and measured ~2.9:1 in dark mode (WCAG AA failure); fg.accent measures 8.5:1 dark / 7.3:1 light.

border-selected.$description: Border/indicator of selected action element (tab underline, segmented active bar). Routes through border.accent (border-role token, numerically identical to fg.accent in both themes) — role-corrected 2026-08-03 from the 2026-07-31 fg.accent re-route: border tokens reference border.* L2; passes the 3:1 non-text minimum in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11); indicator + label share one passing color.

border-focus.$description: Focus ring for all action elements.

bg-accent-2-default.$description: Accent-2 button fill. Dormant: identical to primary.

bg-accent-2-disabled.$description: Disabled fill — shared neutral, same as primary.

fg-accent-2-default.$description: Accent-2 button text — on-color ink role, same as primary.

fg-accent-2-disabled.$description: Disabled text — shared, same as primary.

border-accent-2-default.$description: Accent-2 button border = fill (sanctioned filled-button exception).

border-accent-2-disabled.$description: Disabled border — shared, same as primary.

bg-accent-3-default.$description: Accent-3 button fill. Dormant: identical to primary.

bg-accent-3-disabled.$description: Disabled fill — shared neutral, same as primary.

fg-accent-3-default.$description: Accent-3 button text — on-color ink role, same as primary.

fg-accent-3-disabled.$description: Disabled text — shared, same as primary.

border-accent-3-default.$description: Accent-3 button border = fill (sanctioned filled-button exception).

border-accent-3-disabled.$description: Disabled border — shared, same as primary.

fg-error.$description: Error message text and error-state field text.

border-default.$description: Field border — default. Routes through border.emphasis (the field/control tier) so inputs read as interactive against page bg, distinct from the softer surface borders used for cards and dividers.

border-hover.$description: Field border — hovered. Routes through border.emphasis-bold (neutral.500 in both themes) for a clear contrast bump from resting (neutral.400 light / neutral.700 dark).

border-focus.$description: Field border — focused. Ocean focus ring.

bg-elevated.$description: Elevated surface (modal, dropdown). Shadow applied in code.

bg-overlay.$description: Overlay surface background — floating popups, modals, dropdowns. Matches default page bg; elevation comes from shadow, not a tonal step.

bg-backdrop.$description: Modal/drawer backdrop. Apply 60% opacity in code.

border-cutout.$description: Cutout/separator ring: a border colored to MATCH the base page behind a floating element, so overlapping/floating elements read as separated (avatar-group rings, slider thumb). Intentionally aliases a bg token — the ring must equal the surface, not outline it. Base-surface variant; use -elevated on cards/media chrome.

border-cutout-elevated.$description: Cutout/separator ring for an element floating over an ELEVATED surface (card, media player chrome) rather than the base page. Aliases bg.strong to match the elevated surface.
